verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an on-device inference engine, so real-time on-device speech transcription is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents only text LLM inference and vision (image) multimodal support; nothing covers audio input, speech-to-text or real-time dictation. Vision support is an adjacent feature and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
